names.name: Blocklight
names.description: A pale buff miniature roof and one warm sun arc, with a broad teal ground shadow; focus on daylight moving across your own block.

names.name: Nearcast
names.description: Three simple stepped teal house/roof masses under one soft slate cloud; one bold rain drop, generous negative space; local weather made tangible.

names.name: Porchcast
names.description: One simple porch roof silhouette frames a warm horizon and a single blue raindrop; approachable everyday planning, no people.

typography.status: proposal; generated pixels are not native point measurements

classification.observed: timestamped station/sensor measurement, never automatically at home
classification.forecast: provider estimate, including WeatherKit current estimate
classification.warning: forecast with separate official-message status; demo warning simulated
classification.stale: supplement original category; never a new data kind

freshness_proposal_minutes.failed_fetch_means: unknown warning status; no false all-clear

privacy.approximate_area_disclosure: possible via coarse requests and IP; not anonymity

apple.mockup: plain text placement placeholder; no logo
apple.production: official WeatherAttribution mark + returned legal link
apple.placement: persistent strip below weather/world and outside sheets

nws.placement: warning issuer + official link; observation detail; Sources
nws.api_feed_proposal: direct NWS regional/zone feed; preserve official message
nws.weatherkit_alternative: also preserve supplied Apple alert details link and issuing agency name

motion.forecast_readouts: provider records; no visual interpolation as numeric truth

screens.title: Home block
screens.interaction: Open to one local house; street/aerial toggle; four-hour rail; nearby station observation is secondary and explicitly different from the area forecast.
screens.acceptance: Every visible numeric weather value has its own source badge. Station details must include observation time and station identity in the expanded Sources view.

screens.title: Hour scrub
screens.interaction: Drag or play; the selected valid time is pinned while the same world geometry stays fixed; stop at the available forecast horizon.
screens.acceptance: Interpolation is visual only. Readouts snap to actual valid-hour records. No interpolation presented as an observation; missing intervals are grey/unavailable.

screens.title: NWS warning example
screens.interaction: Warning sheet takes priority over the world and playback; official issuer, validity, original text and official source link.
screens.acceptance: This screen is a SIMULATED warning example. Production warning is FORECAST · official warning, not proof the hazardous event is observed at the home.

screens.title: Rain forecast
screens.interaction: Grey light, wet broad pavement planes and restrained streaks; area precipitation rate remains readable.
screens.acceptance: Wetness is simulated from history. Precipitation probability differs from rate; no deterministic raindrop arrival at the house.

screens.title: Snow forecast
screens.interaction: Cold light, bare trees, exposed pavement and uneven snow appearance; distinguish forecast snowfall from estimated ground cover.
screens.acceptance: Missing accumulation history yields unknown ground coverage. Demo art is illustrative; production should neutralize unsupported coverage rather than initialize a blanket.

screens.title: Fog forecast
screens.interaction: Distance contrast fades while near house and controls stay sharp.
screens.acceptance: Area visibility forecast is not a measured sight distance on the user’s street; do not obscure the text with world fog.

screens.title: Night and simulated lights
screens.interaction: Quiet blue sky, restrained warm lamps/windows, coherent light pools and simulated shadows.
screens.acceptance: Lights do not reveal residents’ activity or smart-home telemetry. Reduce city star density; solar/moon models, geometry and weather govern production light.

screens.title: Settings and stale preview
screens.interaction: Persistent local-home policy; units, motion, notification preferences, deletion and source links; stale example is prominent.
screens.acceptance: Mandatory local home storage is not a toggle. Warning permissions are optional; declining does not hide in-app warnings. Refresh never makes stale data live without a new valid fetch.
